caption: The drawing depicts a cannon with two large spoked wheels. The cannon barrel is colored in shades of tan and brown, with some dark spots and markings along its surface. The carriage, which holds and supports the barrel, is predominantly black with some shading to indicate depth and shape. The two wheels are bright red with black accents outlining the spokes and rim, and the spokes are thin and evenly spaced. The cannon is centered on a light, off-white background that is plain and unadorned, with no other objects or decorative elements present. The overall composition is simple, focusing entirely on the single cannon and its details.
title: Toy Cannon
